text:
Riley Ford: Idea: during next week's hiring open house, set up a small "Thank-You-Interviewer" pop-up where candidates can leave short notes and employees can hand out micro-spot awards to interviewers who went above & beyond. hybrid-friendly.
Sana Ali: neat. love the morale + hiring combo. how do we keep it low-friction?
Riley Ford: tablet + 3-question form (who, quick reason, photo opt-in). instant e-gift option for employees to send to interviewers.
Omar Khan: Facilities can spare a side table near the interview check-in. need power and 2 chairs. I'll reserve it.
Bea Torres: procurement/finance: what's the proposed budget? small $10-$20 tokens? and approval path?
Riley Ford: thinking $10 e-gifts for micro-thanks, plus 5x $75 surprise awards for the week. est total ~ $800 incl buffer.
James R: finance: provisional ok. Any single award >$100 needs my sign-off. Submit PO with vendor details; digital e-gifts preferred.
Sana Ali: volunteers: 2 people per 3-hr block to man the kiosk and help candidates. Will post a signup in the sheet.
Riley Ford: also want a "thank-you wall" where candidates and employees can pin sticky notes. facilities can provide corkboard.
Omar Khan: booked lobby alcove Tue-Fri 10-3. I'll add the cork strip request.
Bea Torres: legal flag: add photo consent and a line about not using candidate feedback in hiring decisions. I'll draft wording.
people-bot: Tip: Use `/issue-spot-award <recipient> <amount> <reason>` to record awards. Tag with `#hiring-thanks` for reporting.
Sana Ali: remote interviewers: we need a shipping option if someone prefers physical swag. collect addresses securely.
Riley Ford: remote flow: QR -> short form that writes to the event sheet. volunteers can trigger people-bot for e-gift issuance.
James R: vendor note: ensure e-gift vendor supports bulk CSV upload and same-day delivery. cc me on the PO.
Bea Torres: consent text draft: "I consent to my note and photo being used internally for recognition and agree that feedback will not impact candidacy." will add to the form.
Sana Ali: poster + small table tent copy in the doc. will keep language: "Say thanks 25 in 60s"
Riley Ford: action items: Omar reserves space + power; Sana posts volunteer signup; Bea finalizes consent + PO template; James to approve PO once submitted.
people-bot: Automation: volunteers tagged `#hiring-thanks-vol` will get a DM 24h before shift.
Omar Khan: will confirm corkboard pickup time.
Sana Ali: will run a 15min volunteer walk-through Tue morning.
Riley Ford: thanks all — closing thread for now, will reopen if blockers. :handshake:
